$comment: EXPERIMENTAL — Strategic Core Sprint 1 + Sprint 2 (Strategic Reasoning). Canonical StrategicInsight model. Not registered or consumed by contracts.js, analyzer.js or handler.js yet. functional_role_assessment, hidden_asset_assessment, audience_classification and self_critique are Sprint 2 shapes, still intentionally left out of `required`: their absence must read as "not evaluated", never as "evaluated, nothing found". Semantic cross-field invariants (e.g. ACTUAL_FRICTION requiring rupture_evidence_refs, hidden asset existence/utilization consistency) live in validateStrategicInsights (strategic-insight.js), not in this schema — see that function for the full list.
title: Strategic Insight V1 (experimental)

source_finding_refs.description: N:1 by design: one or more findings/signals this insight consolidates. A legacy adapter may populate exactly one ref per insight; that is a lift strategy, not a modeling constraint.

evidence_refs.description: Direct evidentiary basis for this insight's own claim.

validation_required.description: Whether this insight needs human/QA validation before being surfaced. Always computable, not a placeholder.

derivation_method.description: Explicit provenance of the insight, so no consumer can mistake a mechanical lift for a full strategic assessment.

objective_relation.description: Relation of this insight to the client's stated primary_goal/desired_perceptions. Optional: present only when actually judged.

evidence_strength.description: Epistemic strength of the reasoning chain behind this insight. Independent from evidence_state (availability/applicability).

evidence_state.description: Availability/applicability of the underlying evidence. Distinct from evidence_strength (epistemic strength).

alternative_explanations.description: Reserved for Strategic Reasoning. Present only when that capability actually ran.

contradictory_evidence_refs.description: Evidence that weakens or contests this insight's own claim. Not the mechanism for representing CONTRADICTION-type insights, which instead consolidate conflicting findings via source_finding_refs.

chain_stage.description: Null when candidate chain stages disagreed and attribution to a single stage was not forced (see Sprint 2 plan).

rupture_evidence_refs.description: Non-empty only when role is ACTUAL_FRICTION; see validateStrategicInsights for the enforced invariant.

functional_role_assessment.description: Functional Role model (Sprint 2). 'Difference is not deficiency': a deviation only becomes ACTUAL_FRICTION when a demonstrable chain rupture backs it, never by default.

asset_existence.description: The only two states assessHiddenAsset can produce: existence is a pure membership check against known evidence ids, never a criteria-derived signal.

strategic_utilization.description: Whether the asset is actually propagated into other chain stages, not just recognized where first credited. Independent from asset_existence.

hidden_asset_assessment.description: Hidden Asset model (Sprint 2). asset_existence and strategic_utilization are deliberately separate: an asset already credited by a SUPPORTED criterion can still be a hidden asset if under-utilized. See validateStrategicInsights for the enforced existence/utilization invariant.

categories.description: Cardinality N: the same evidence/relationship can serve more than one audience function at once. No hierarchy — COMMERCIAL_AUDIENCE is not privileged over the rest.

audience_classification.description: Audience Quality / Strategic Network model (Sprint 2). No audience/follower metrics are ever collected; classification is text-mention-based only.

reasons.description: escalate=false requires reasons=[]; see validateStrategicInsights for the enforced invariant.

self_critique.description: Strategic Self-Critique model (Sprint 2). Consults capability_execution_state (internal to strategic-analyzer.js, never serialized) rather than output-field presence/absence — not represented here.
